To ensure hardware level stability, native peripheral, power cross routing and monolithic driver, firmwar e validation, all key hardware items constituting the composite computing tablet bundle (Specifically the c ore computing tablet, the custom magnetic docking key board case, and the active stylus smart pen must be manufactured by the same OEM. Alternatively, if multi-brand components are supplied, the bidder must upload a comprehensive cross-compatibility and structural integration certification officially signed by the primary tablet OEM. This certification must explicitly guarantee that all ancillary items utilised native, syst em-level operating system APIs for power delivery, pairing, and touch-surface data translation without req uiring third-party background software drivers or independent utility installions. 2. The primary bidder shall assume absolute operational responsibility for the entirety of the supplied eco s ystem. In the event of any interoperability breakdown, firmware mismatch or physical pairing defect acros s the supplied components during the tenure of the warranty, the buyer will hold the primary bidder directl y liable for the complete system rectification or immediate replacement under a single service ticket frame work. 3. To streamline intake auditing, prevent mixed-brand confusion and maintain rigorous deployment protoc ols, all three functional components (Computing tablet, Interactive Keyboard and Active Stylus) must be b undled, packed and delivered down to the end user delivery location as a single, cohesive, factory-sealed o perational kit under a unified stock keeping unit. 4. Split shipments, loose individual components deliveries from divergent regional logistics channels or fac ed handovers of accessories on distinct dates will be treated as a critical delivery failure, leading to the im mediate rejection of the consignment at the consignee site. 5. The bidder must supply a minimum 1 year comprehensive manufacturer warranty covering all three con

stituent items against hardware failure, manufacturing defects and erratic battery degradation from the of ficial date of administrative acceptance at the consignee hub. 6. The OEM or its officially authorised service partner must have a functional, verifiable regional service su pport architecture within the state of delivery. Any reported hardware glitch must be acknowledged within 24 Hrs, and resolved or provisioned with a matching standby unit within 48 business hours. 7. The bidder must upload official, unedited technical datasheets and product brochures published directly by the respective OEM. Any discrepancy found between self declared technical compliance values on the GeM portal and the official OEM literature will result in immediate technical disqualification. . 6.
